name: avalara-exemption-certificates
title: Avalara Exemption Certificates
summary: Provides access to Avalara Exemption Certificate Management for certificates, profiles, company data
description: Avalara Exemption Certificate Management MCP server provides AI agents access to exemption certificates, customer profiles, and company data. Agents can list or filter certificates and customers, and search companies to obtain IDs required for ECM operations, over streamable HTTP with OAuth 2.1.

useCases.name: Certificate inventory management
useCases.description: List and filter exemption certificates for a company, including validity status, to support sales tax exemption compliance.

useCases.name: Customer profile lookup
useCases.description: Retrieve customer profiles and related certificate information for exemption validation during sales or audit workflows.

useCases.name: Company search for ECM operations
useCases.description: Search companies by name to obtain company IDs required for certificate and customer management operations.
